text: dsh-mineru 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 MinerU 文档解析插件，通过渐进式工具注册和 Web 设置界面接入，可把 PDF、Office 文档、HTML 与图片解析为结构化 Markdown，支持单份与批量解析、页码范围、OCR、任务结果收集及工作区 Artifact。适合需要让 DSH Agent 阅读文档并提取内容的用户；可配置 MinerU Token 使用精准 API，也可不配 Token 使用轻量 Agent API。解析会将文件发送至 MinerU。

dsh-mineru adds MinerU parsing to DSH Web. It turns PDFs, Office files, HTML, and images into structured Markdown, supports batch jobs, and saves workspace artifacts. Use a token for precision parsing or the lightweight Agent API; documents are uploaded to MinerU.
想让 DSH 帮我把 PDF 转成带表格结构的 Markdown。
有没有办法批量解析一批本地文档和网页链接？
扫描版图片和 PDF 能不能做 OCR 后交给 Agent 阅读？
我想按页码范围提取长 PDF 的内容并整理成 Markdown。
I want my DSH agent to extract readable Markdown from PDFs and office documents.
Can I submit a batch of document files and URLs for parsing in DSH?
dsh-mineru 的功能「单文档解析」：通过 mineru_parse 提交工作区文件或 HTTP URL，将支持的 PDF、Office 文档、HTML 或图片解析并把结果保存为工作区 Artifact。
dsh-mineru 的功能「批量文档解析」：通过 mineru_batch_parse 混合提交本地路径和 URL；插件按批次上限处理，并逐项返回成功或失败结果。
dsh-mineru 的功能「查询并收集任务结果」：通过 mineru_task 使用任务 ID 查询提交后的解析进度；任务完成后可下载并保存结果，便于在解析超时后继续收取。
dsh-mineru 的功能「拖放文件到聊天」：在 Web 聊天中拖入文档或图片后，插件将文件保存到会话工作区并把路径填入输入草稿，供用户补充请求后发送。
dsh-mineru 使用 MinerU 远程解析；文档内容会上传至 MinerU 服务，代码没有离线解析路径。
想一次性把很多资料文件解析后分别保存成 Markdown。
I need to check a parsing task later and collect its output without submitting the document again.
dsh-mineru 提供工具 mineru_activate：激活 MinerU 多模态文档解析工具集 (mineru_parse / mineru_batch_parse / mineru_task).
dsh-mineru 提供工具 mineru_parse：用 MinerU 解析单个文档为结构化 Markdown
dsh-mineru 提供工具 mineru_batch_parse：用 MinerU 精准解析 API 批量解析文档 (需要 Token)
dsh-mineru 提供工具 mineru_task：查询 (并可选收集) 一个已提交的 MinerU 任务
dsh-mineru 提供声明项 mineru-tools：Agent-facing manual for parsing tools

dsh-mineru README · dsh-mineru：**dsh-mineru** is a **MinerU-powered multimodal document parsing plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh): turn PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, HTML, and images into **structured Markdown**. Configure a MinerU token to use the 🎯 Precision API, or leave it blank and use the ⚡ Agent API (tokenless, IP rate-limited).

dsh-mineru README · dsh-mineru：> ⚠️ **Data leaves this machine**: every parse uploads your file to MinerU's remote service — there is **no fully offline mode**. Do not use it for confidential / case material that must stay on-premises. See [Security model](#security-model).

dsh-mineru README · Contents：- [Overview](#overview) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Two API modes](#two-api-modes) · [Tools](#tools) · [Results & artifacts](#results--artifacts) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [Usage tips](#usage-tips) · [Web UI](#web-ui) · [Rate limits & reliability](#rate-limits--reliability) · [Error code reference](#error-code-reference) · [Security model](#security-model) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Development & publishing](#development--publishing) · [Contributing](#contributing) · [License](#license)

dsh-mineru README · What is this?：dsh-mineru plugs [MinerU](https://mineru.net) (OpenDataLab's high-precision document parsing engine) into the DeepSeek Harness agent ecosystem, letting **text-only models "read" documents**: the model receives structured Markdown (tables, formulas, and images preserved) instead of binary files it cannot open.

Typical use cases:

dsh-mineru README · Supported file formats：| Format | Precision API (token required) | Agent API (tokenless) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PDF | ✅ | ✅ |
| Word (`.doc` / `.docx`) | ✅ | ✅ (`.docx` only) |
| PPT (`.ppt` / `.pptx`) | ✅ | ✅ (`.pptx` only) |
| Excel (`.xls` / `.xlsx`) | ✅ | ✅ (`.xlsx` only) |
| HTML (`.html` / `.htm`) | ✅ (forces MinerU-HTML model) | ❌ |
| Images (`.png` `.jpg` `.jpeg` `.jp2` `.webp` `.gif` `.bmp`) | ✅ | ✅ |
dsh-mineru README · Supported file formats：> Note: the Agent API does not support `.doc` / `.ppt` / `.xls` (legacy Office formats) or HTML — use the Precision API (token required) for those.

dsh-mineru README · Step 1: Install：> **Note**: Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.1` or newer on the `0.2.0` line, or a compatible `0.1.5-rc.x` installation, with the `dsh` CLI available. On the `0.2.0` line, use plugin `0.1.15` or later: `0.1.14` covers only `0.2.0-rc.2+`, `0.1.13` only the older host range. If npm still serves `0.1.13`, install a source-built tarball below.

**From npm (recommended)**

dsh-mineru README · Step 1: Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mineru        # Web profile
dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-mineru   # Headless profile
```

**Build from source** (development / preview latest changes)

```bash
git clone git@github.com:Lee-Hilex/dsh-mineru.git
cd dsh-mineru
npm ci             # development: Node.js 24 recommended; no build step
npm test           # includes real DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 integration tests

dsh-mineru README · Step 1: Install：Run `npm pack` again and re-install after changing the source. Local installs must use the tarball (`pnpm link:` installs resolve `@deepseek-ai` peers outside the profile).

dsh-mineru README · Step 1: Install：For the desktop profile, use `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-mineru-0.1.14.tgz`. Compatible package metadata passes the runtime gate without an `allow-version` exemption. `npm run test:compat` runs only the real-runtime compatibility checks; MinerU responses are simulated, so the tests upload no documents and consume no API quota.

dsh-mineru README · Step 2: Verify the install：```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A 2 "id: mineru"
```

Expected output (a `# ==` comment line plus your plugin row):

```

dsh-mineru README · == dsh-mineru：- id: mineru
    name: dsh-mineru
```

Then restart a running Web profile (`dsh web`) and open **Settings → Plugins → MinerU 解析**.

dsh-mineru README · Step 3: Configure (optional)：The token is resolved once per operation — **rotations take effect on the very next call without a restart**. Get a token by registering at <https://mineru.net> (API management page).

dsh-mineru README · Step 4: Use it：**Headless smoke test**: one-off tasks run on the headless profile:

```bash
dsh --profile headless "Parse C:/docs/sample.pdf to Markdown and summarize the first 3 paragraphs"
```

Headless and Web share the same tool semantics; you can also type `/mineru-tools` in a conversation to load the usage skill.

dsh-mineru README · Two API modes：| | 🎯 Precision API (token required) | ⚡ Agent API (tokenless) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Endpoints | `/api/v4/extract/task`, `/api/v4/file-urls/batch`, `/api/v4/extract/task/batch` | `/api/v1/agent/parse/url`, `/api/v1/agent/parse/file` |
| Models | `pipeline` / `vlm` (default) / `MinerU-HTML` | fixed lightweight pipeline |
| Size limit | ≤ 200 MB | ≤ 10 MB |
| Page limit | ≤ 200 pages per request (workspace PDFs over it are split automatically) | ≤ 20 pages (never split) |
| Batch parsing | ✅ (URLs ≤ 200/batch, local uploads ≤ 50/batch, auto-batched) | ❌ single file only |
| Output | Zip: `full.md` + `content_list.json` + `layout.json` + images (+ optional docx/html/latex) | Markdown only |
| Best for | Long docs, scans, formulas/tables, batch jobs, HTML | Quick reads, small files, temporary use |

dsh-mineru README · Tools：By default the toolset is **progressively exposed**: only the `mineru_activate` bootstrap is registered at first. One call unlocks the other three tools, and `mineru_activate` then hides itself for that session.

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_activate` — activation bootstrap：| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Purpose | Unlocks `mineru_parse` / `mineru_batch_parse` / `mineru_task` and loads the `mineru-tools` skill |
| Parameters | none |
| Returns | A status summary: effective API mode, token configured or not, per-API limits |

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_parse` — parse a single document：| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | ✅ | Workspace file path, or full http(s) URL |
| `mode` | | `auto` (default) / `precision` / `agent` |
| `modelVersion` | | Precision model: `pipeline` / `vlm` (default, recommended) / `MinerU-HTML` (forced automatically for HTML sources) |
| `language` | | Document language pack, default `ch` — see [Configuration](#configuration) |
| `enableTable` | | Table recognition, default `true` |
| `enableFormula` | | Formula recognition, default `true` |
| `isOcr` | | Force OCR for scans, default `false` |
| `pageRanges` | | Precision page ranges, comma-separated: `"2,4-6"`; negative pages supported: `"2--2"` (2nd from last). Omit for the whole document; a workspace PDF over the 200-page cap is split automatically |
| `pageRange` | | Agent page range, `from-to` or single page: `"1-10"` |
| `extraFormats` | | Extra export formats (Precision only): `docx` / `html` / `latex` |
| `dataId` | | Business data ID (optional, ≤ 128 chars) |
| `timeoutMs` | | Whole-operation timeout incl. polling; defaults to plugin config (10 min) |
| `output` | | Result directory base

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_parse` — parse a single document：**Result highlights**: `ok`, the `api`/`modelVersion` used, `taskId`, duration, `runDir`, a truncated Markdown preview, the artifact list (with signed preview links on Web), and — with `anchor: true` — an `anchor` summary naming the `document.md` that was written.

dsh-mineru README · Page-anchored Markdown (`anchor`)：`full.md` is prose: nothing in it says which page a sentence came from, so a
claim drawn from a scan cannot be cited back to a page. `anchor: true` adds a
`document.md` that carries that information as an HTML comment per block:

```
<!-- p12 b3 -->
君子务本，本立而道生。

<!-- p12 b4 -->

dsh-mineru README · Page-anchored Markdown (`anchor`)：- `pN` is the **physical page position in this file** (1-based, cover and front
  matter included) — not the page number printed on the page. The cloud
  renumbers the pages you asked for, so with `pageRanges: "2,4-6"` the anchors
  are `p2, p4, p5, p6` — the mapping is `requestedPages[page_idx]`, not a fixed
  offset;
- `bK` is the K-th block **of that page** in `content_list.json` order. Page
  headers, footers and page numbers stay out of the body but still occupy their
  number, so `bK` can have gaps (e.g. `b1, b2, b4`) — that is deliberate: `bK`
  always names the same record in `content_list.json`;
- text blocks render their text, a cloud heading level becomes the matching
  Markdown heading, tables render as their caption plus `table_body`, images as
  ``;
- a block the cloud marked `[Unreadable]` keeps its anchor and shows
  `[Unreadable]`; a block with empty text keeps its anchor too;
- the precision API is the only mode that returns `content_list.json`, so
  `anchor: true` under the Agent API returns a warning and no `document.md`
  instead of failing.

dsh-mineru README · Page-anchored Markdown (`anchor`)：The number printed on a page is a *printed* page number, and it need not match
the physical order: front matter numbered with Roman numerals, or a document
that keeps the page numbers of the journal it came from, shifts every later
page. When the result carries readable `page_number` blocks the renderer
compares them with the physical order on a best-effort basis, records each
page's `printed − physical` difference in the `pageNumbers` field of the
`anchor` summary (`{ detected, total, offsets }`, `offsets` sorted and
de-duplicated), and reports a single constant non-zero difference as one
warning line (messages are Chinese, like the rest of the renderer's warnings):

dsh-mineru README · Page-anchored Markdown (`anchor`)：```
anchor.pageNumbers = { "detected": 4, "total": 4, "offsets": [3] }
anchor.warnings    = ["印刷页码与物理页序整体相差 +3（前言用罗马数字，或用析出文献保留原刊页码，都会造成整体偏移）；锚点仍用物理页序，可用页码映射声明两者的对应关系"]
```

Several different differences are reported as such and need checking page by
page. Nothing is reported when the two agree (every offset `0`) or when no
printed number could be read. The check only reads the blocks: the anchors are
never changed by it.

dsh-mineru README · Page-anchored Markdown (`anchor`)：Without `pageRanges` the pages are numbered from 1 in request order. With a
negative range (`"2--2"`) the cloud does not tell us the document length, so the
anchors fall back to the first page you asked for and the result carries a
warning telling you to check them.

dsh-mineru README · Page-anchored Markdown (`anchor`)：**Long PDFs — automatic chunking**: when one precision request would ask for more than 200 pages (a workspace PDF larger than that, or a `pageRanges` selection over 200 pages), the plugin splits it into sequential `page_ranges` chunks itself, submits and polls them one by one, and merges the outcome into the layout a single request produces. No extra parameter, and no local PDF rewrite: the file is uploaded once, only the requested range changes per request.

dsh-mineru README · Page-anchored Markdown (`anchor`)：Boundaries: splitting needs the page count **locally**, so it covers workspace PDFs in precision mode only. URL sources, non-PDF formats (the host cannot read docx/pptx page counts) and the tokenless Agent API keep their previous behaviour, and their page-limit error names the reason no split happened. The Agent API is deliberately never split: it is rate-limited per caller IP, so fanning one call out into a dozen requests would exhaust the caller's quota — use Precision, or segment it yourself. `timeoutMs` applies to each chunk. Only a merged multi-chunk result renumbers pages; a single request (including one with an explicit `pageRanges`) keeps the cloud's own `page_idx`, exactly as before.

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_batch_parse` — batch parsing (Precision only)：Parses many documents in one call; **local paths and URLs can be mixed**, submissions are auto-chunked within official limits, and per-item success/failure is reported.

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_batch_parse` — batch parsing (Precision only)：| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sources` | ✅ | Mixed list of file paths / URLs |
| `outputPrefix` | | Result directory base name, default `batch` |
| `dataIdPrefix` | | Business data ID prefix; a sequence number is appended per item (optional) |
| `anchor` | | Same as `mineru_parse`: write a `document.md` per document (default `false`) |
| others | | Same shared options as `mineru_parse` (except `mode` — this tool is Precision-only) |

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_batch_parse` — batch parsing (Precision only)：**Chunking rules**: local files ≤ 50 per batch, URLs ≤ 200 per batch, ≤ 1000 total per call; exceeding these errors with a hint to split the call.

**Result highlights**: success/failure counts, `batchId`s, per-item results (each success includes its `full.md` directory), and error messages for failures.

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_task` — task query & result collection：**A timed-out parse is never lost**: use the `taskId` + `api` returned by `mineru_parse` to query progress and collect results later — no resubmission needed.

dsh-mineru README · `mineru_task` — task query & result collection：| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `taskId` | ✅ | The task_id returned when the task was submitted |
| `api` | ✅ | Which API owns the task: `precision` or `agent` |
| `wait` | | Poll until the task finishes, default `false` (query once) |
| `collect` | | Download the result into an Artifact when done, default `true` |
| `output` | | Result directory base name, default `task` |
| `anchor` | | Also write `document.md` when collecting (default `false`) |
| `timeoutMs` | | Timeout for `wait` mode |
dsh-mineru README · `mineru_task` — task query & result collection：**Typical scenario**: `mineru_parse` timed out on a large PDF → tell the agent "collect the result for taskId=xxx with mineru_task".

dsh-mineru README · `mineru-tools` skill：The plugin ships a skill of the same name. Type `/mineru-tools` in a conversation or ask the agent to load it via the `skill` tool: it contains the full agent-facing manual — tool list, dual-API comparison, usage notes, and official limits.

dsh-mineru README · Results & artifacts：All results land in **`<workspace>/.dsh-mineru/artifacts/<run>/`** (`<workspace>` is the session workspace, `<run>` a fresh directory per parse):

```
.dsh-mineru/artifacts/<run>/
├── full.md                  # Structured Markdown (both modes)
├── run.json                 # Run metadata (source, API, model, duration, …)
├── document.md              # Page-anchored Markdown (Precision + anchor: true only)
dsh-mineru README · Results & artifacts：Batch parses keep each document in its own subdirectory: `<run>/<file-name>/full.md`.

dsh-mineru README · Configuration：Configuration resolves in three layers, later wins: **schema defaults ← composition layer (the `mineru` row config in a profile patch) ← user settings (written through the Web Settings card)**.

```yaml

dsh-mineru README · Composition-layer example (cordis.patch.yml or a profile patch)：- id: mineru
  config:
    mode: auto               # auto | precision | agent
    modelVersion: vlm        # pipeline | vlm | MinerU-HTML
    language: ch             # document language pack
    enableTable: true        # table recognition
    enableFormula: true      # formula recognition
    isOcr: false             # force OCR
    extraFormats: []         # docx | html | latex (Precision only)
    exposeMode: progressive  # progressive: bootstrap activation; always: register everything globally
    timeoutMs: 600000        # whole-operation timeout (ms)
    pollIntervalMs: 3000     # result poll interval (ms)
    inlineMarkdownBytes: 12000  # inline preview bytes in tool results
    submitRatePerMin: 40     # submission rate cap (per minute)
    pollRatePerMin: 900      # query rate cap (per minute)
    dailySubmitLimit: 5000   # daily submission cap
    artifactRootName: .dsh-mineru  # artifact root directory name
```

dsh-mineru README · Rate limits & reliability：**Official MinerU limits** (the plugin enforces local equivalents and backoff; requests beyond the limits are rejected with HTTP 429):

| Dimension | Official limit | Plugin local default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Submissions | 50 files/min | 40/min |
| Daily submissions | 5000 files/day/user (HTML: max 100/day) | 5000 (fails fast locally) |
| Result queries | 1000/min | 900/min |

Plugin behavior:

dsh-mineru README · Error code reference：| Code | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `A0202` / `A0211` | Token invalid / expired | Update the MinerU token in Settings |
| `-60005` / `-30001` | File too large (200 MB / 10 MB) | Compress or split the file |
| `-60006` / `-30003` | Too many pages (200 / 20) | Workspace PDFs are split automatically; for anything else the message names why no split happened — segment manually with `pageRanges` / `pageRange` |
| `-60018` | Daily quota exhausted | Try again tomorrow; check `dailySubmitLimit` |
| `429` | Too many requests | Retry later or lower concurrency |
| `MINERU_TOKEN_REQUIRED` | Token-required operation without a token | Configure a token or use Agent mode |
| `MINERU_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE` | Format unsupported by the current API | Switch format or API mode |
| `MINERU_BATCH_TOO_LARGE` | Batch exceeds 1000 items | Split into multiple calls |
dsh-mineru README · Error code reference：Every error is mapped to an **actionable message** instead of a raw code.

dsh-mineru README · Data flow (where your content goes)：**This plugin is not offline.** Both API modes send the full source file to a remote MinerU service, then download the parsed result — nothing is parsed on this machine.

dsh-mineru README · Data flow (where your content goes)：| Operation | Leaves the machine? | Endpoint | Token |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Precision parse / batch / task collect | Yes — file uploaded, result zip downloaded | `https://mineru.net` (result CDN: `https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn`) | Required |
| Agent lightweight parse | Yes — file uploaded, Markdown downloaded | MinerU Agent API | None (IP rate-limited) |
| Activation / settings / local preview | No file content leaves (only the token test makes one authenticated API call) | — | — |

dsh-mineru README · Data flow (where your content goes)：There is **no "local-only" mode**: MinerU runs server-side. For material that cannot leave the machine, use a fully local toolchain (local PDF conversion + offline OCR + local template rendering).

dsh-mineru README · FAQ：**Q: Can I use it without a token?**
Yes. It falls back to the tokenless Agent API (≤ 10 MB, ≤ 20 pages, Markdown only) — fine for quick reads.

**Q: Why is only `mineru_activate` in my tool list?**
That is progressive exposure by design. Call `mineru_activate` once and the other three tools unlock; or set `exposeMode: always` to register everything globally.

dsh-mineru README · FAQ：**Q: My parse timed out — is the file lost?**
No. The task keeps running on MinerU's servers; use `mineru_task` (`taskId` + `api`) anytime to query progress and collect the result without resubmitting.

**Q: Why didn't the parse start after I dropped a file?**
Drag-and-drop only fills the path into the composer draft (to avoid accidental sends). Add your request and press send; the agent then starts parsing.

dsh-mineru README · FAQ：**Q: A0202 / A0211 errors?**
The token is invalid or expired. Re-enter it in Settings → Plugins → MinerU 解析 (a blank save keeps the old value).

**Q: Can I parse HTML pages?**
Yes, but Precision API only (token required), and the MinerU-HTML model is forced. Note the server cannot reach blocked URLs.

**Q: How do I batch-parse?**
Use `mineru_batch_parse` with a list of paths/URLs — auto-chunked (local ≤ 50/batch, URLs ≤ 200/batch, ≤ 1000 per call).

dsh-mineru README · FAQ：**Q: What's the difference between the Agent and Precision results?**
Agent produces Markdown only. Precision additionally yields `content_list.json`, `layout.json`, `model.json`, embedded images, optional docx/html/latex exports, and table/formula recognition controls.

dsh-mineru README · Development & publishing：No build step: `lib/` ships loadable ESM and `lib/client.js` is the packed browser bundle.

```bash
node --check lib/*.js      # syntax check
npm pack                   # pack a local tarball
```

For a new release, follow the checklist in [RELEASE.md](RELEASE.md) (bump version → update CHANGELOG and both READMEs → pack & verify → tag & push → `npm publish`); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full development loop.
dsh-mineru README · Contributing：Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Please **never paste a MinerU token** into an issue.
